about.heroLead: The home page is the ten-second version. This is the part that's nicer to read once you're interested: how I want to work, what I do outside work, and how I got into development.
about.personEyebrow: what kind of person I am
about.personTitle: What kind of person I am
about.personIntro: Ukrainian citizen, currently living in Bucharest. A bit about how I work and what matters to me — beyond the resume bullets.
person: I take the whole task — I'd rather carry a feature from mockup to production and deploy than hand it off in pieces.
I don't panic when things are on fire: prod bugs and regressions under load are about focusing and fixing, not stress.
I learn by building — I pick up new things through pet projects, from Electron apps to bots and mobile.
I like clarity: I untangle other people's legacy carefully and leave the code cleaner than I found it.
I'm a team person — I work easily with backend, testers and the designer, and step in with clients when the technical side is needed.
work: Or hybrid in Miami, New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco or New Orleans — with visa sponsorship that covers relocating with my spouse.
Russian, English or Ukrainian inside the team — all fine with me.

descriptions.whiteslove: A personal platform of online tools: PDF editor, JSON merge, DockerHub tag search, email/markdown/SVG editors. The same stack as my main work — Nuxt with SSR, multi-language, a custom REST backend.
descriptions.personal-site-backend: The backend for the site's own services: a FastAPI REST API, file processing (PDF, conversion), Redis caching. It powers the tools in the catalog.
descriptions.account-status-api-lost-ark: The API behind the online module of the Account Status (Lost Ark) app.
descriptions.i18n-properties-manager: A localization-files manager, including .ftlh (Freemarker) — the same tech I use at BPC. Compare, merge and edit translation keys.
descriptions.lost-ark: Automatically pulls character data by parsing HTML, and tracks in-game activities with a scheduled auto-reset.
descriptions.account-status-lost-ark: A desktop app to save and check character status in Lost Ark (built for personal use). Its online module runs on a separate Node API.
descriptions.medikit: A home medicine-cabinet tracker: expiry dates, remaining stock, and shared family access.
descriptions.fun-things-tracker: Search, track and group what you want to (or already did) watch, read or visit: manga, books, films, series, places.
descriptions.rustic-price-converter: Currency conversion and on-the-fly price comparison.
descriptions.genshin-impact-bot: An open group bot: mini-games (cards, slots, bowling, bosses), an XP / loot / gear system, and admin tools for managing members.
descriptions.lost-ark-trading-discord-bot: A Discord bot for Lost Ark trading.
descriptions.file-telegram-bot: A Telegram bot for handling files.
descriptions.increase-hard-mod-r-e-p-o: A difficulty mod for a co-op game: scales enemies by run progress, adds random per-level modifiers and a team ping system over Photon.
descriptions.autotranslatetexts: A Skyrim patcher: auto-translates mod strings using already-existing translations (not a machine translator).
descriptions.freefasttravel: A Synthesis patcher for Skyrim: removes the fast-travel lock from exterior locations without touching quest ones.
descriptions.allbookshaveperks: A Skyrim patcher: adds a random perk to every book in the game.
descriptions.moregoldformerchants: A mod that increases the amount of gold merchants carry.
